title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11
source: Master soundboard reels > DAT > CD > Plextor PX-708A extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 5) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool v2.0.3) > .flac encoding (flac v1.1.0)

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard recording of a star‑studded show highlighted by an epic Dark Star → Spanish Jam → Lovelight sequence
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this February 1970 New York performance, calling the Dark Star/Spanish Jam/Lovelight suite cosmic and describing the tape as crystal‑clear with well‑executed patch work. The many guest musicians (Duane Allman, Peter Green, Mick Fleetwood, etc.) add a rare, free‑form energy while Jerry’s single‑coil tones and Mickey’s gong give the show its own flavor; only one reviewer lamented the change in Garcia’s tone.

ai_rating.rationale: Over ten reviews, average rating is ~4.7 with unanimous praise for both performance and sound quality; only a single low‑star comment mentions stylistic preference, not technical flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Superb clarity and balance throughout; patches fill missing sections without audible seams; no reported dropouts or major mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds from an expansive Dark Star into a seamless Spanish Jam and resolves with an ethereal Lovelight, creating a cohesive, cosmic arc highlighted by guest solos and powerful percussion.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is praised for its intensity and the distinctive single‑coil tone heard on this night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh provides solid bass foundations, even stepping back during Lovelight to let guests shine; he was surprised by Duane’s slide in Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Guest organist Gregg Allman delivers soulful slides and verses that add a bluesy edge to the jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart’s gong work and contributions from guest drummers (Butch, Mick Fleetwood) give the rhythm section extra power and texture.
